name: Checkout Champ for WooCommerce/ WordPress
author: CheckoutChamp

sections.description:
Increase conversion rates, average order value, and subscriptions in WooCommerce/ WordPress today! Easy to install and see results immediately.

Special Offer: Receive the highly sought after 4 part Ecommerce Growth Masterclass at NO CHARGE, and learn the simple steps used to 4X sales revenue.

Checkout Champ solves the biggest problems in ecommerce platforms – slow load times that increase bounce rates and low conversion rates, limited checkout functionality, and high fees – saving thousands of fees each month and helping you SUPERCHARGE your sales.

With a cart load speed of 1 second or less, this fully customizable checkout app is 10x faster than standard checkout pages, making sure no sale is left behind.

Thousands of ecommerce businesses trust Checkout Champ, as it has proven over and over again how it can 2-3X your sales conversions, boost subscription opt-ins by 15%, and increase AOV by at least $20 with its pre and post purchase one-click upsells.

When running an ecommerce business, the last thing you need is to strangle your storefront with slow, poor converting checkout pages and a handful of apps that further bog down your site’s loading time.

Checkout Champ’s robust CRM solution can entirely replace up to 4-5 different apps and integrations that are slowing down your site… allowing you to channel your savings to other revenue-boosting activities.

Here’s what Checkout Champ can do for you:

  • Eliminate and replace slow-loading, low-converting native checkout pages with beautiful, totally customized, lightning-fast checkout pages that convert at a much higher rate.
  • One-Click-Upsells boosting average order value, lifetime value, and conversions plus pre-purchase order bumps.
  • Customize your checkout page with pre-purchase order bumps, testimonials, videos, images, and trigger pop-ups for subscriptions and cross-sells.
  • Create unlimited high-converting sales pages and upsell funnels with Checkout Champ’s powerful landing page builder.
  • Streamline all business processes in one hub. Access all your data and KPIs in ONE powerful central dashboard with ONE login.
  • Advanced reporting and analytical suite. Track web traffic, affiliates, transactions, chargebacks, fraudulent charges, sales, upsells, subscriptions, memberships, AOV, and CLTV on all your stores and sales pages.
  • Get your very own dedicated Client Success Manager who’ll provide you with round-the-clock support in every step of the process – from CRM migration, to onboarding, to making sure all your customer information is transferred to Checkout Champ without a hitch.
  • Incorporate A/B/C/D split testing to optimize every part of your sales process and help you to find the winning sales page fast.
  • Advanced customer data as Checkout Champ captures every keystroke even if the customer bounces off page before clicking the ‘Buy’ button.
  • Over 500 partner integrations to help you run your business smoothly and efficiently with your favorite partners.
  • Save money while you scale as Checkout Champ eliminates the need to pay for multiple different apps that slow down your site. You can now channel your budget to other revenue-boosting activities.
  • Create a fully functional membership portal in just one click and replace your native member’s area within 5-10 minutes.
  • Boost customer lifetime value with the easiest and most versatile subscription billing system in the industry. You can give your customers the option to have your products conveniently delivered to their doorstep every month without having to re-order.
  • Customers can pay in their preferred currency as Checkout Champ supports dynamic currency conversions for over 100 currencies and over 270 payment gateway integrations, including Klarna, Afterpay, Affirm, PayPal, Amazon Payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Checkout Champ automatically converts currencies at NO extra cost.
  • Automates customers’ fulfillment process by sending orders directly to fulfillment companies like ShipStation, ShipBob, ShippingEasy, and more.
  • Customers get a dedicated client success manager for top-tier support.
  • Easily sync all products, variations, and price points with a click of a button.
  • Protect against fraud and chargebacks as you scale your business with easy to deploy tools.

Quickly integrate your new fully customized and lightning-fast checkout page to your storefront, and watch your sales soar. Checkout Champ has proven success on tens of thousands of high revenue stores!

CLICK HERE TO LEARN MORE!
sections.installation:
1. Upload CheckoutChamp.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
